title: Tenma Saki — Featuring Pompompurin〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Satellite Puroland

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! So this is Puroland...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It looks so cute with all the ribbons and flowers everywhere.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Hehe, I'm so glad I finally got to come here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, technically this is just a satellite location of the real Sanrio Puroland.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We should make sure to thank Tsukasa again for the tickets.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's really amazing he and the others get to put on a show here. They're performing at the Wisdom Tree Stage, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! And after the show, MORE MORE JUMP! is doing an event with My Mel!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh right...
My sister said something about them standing in for a famous streamer who couldn't make it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow. I hope we get to see that too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! But we've still got time before curtain, so let's explore!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want us to ring Hello Kitty's Bell of Happiness together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Bell of Happiness?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! They say when people ring the bell together, their bond becomes everlasting!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't know they had something like that. That's kind of romantic.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, isn't it?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, then let's ring it. Which way do we go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's right above the Wisdom Tree where my brother's doing his show! C'mon, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No way...
The line for the bell is crazy long!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: With this many people ahead of us, we'll be waiting forever...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come on, Saki, let's line up too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah. If we line up now, we can probably still make it back for Tsukasa and the others' show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, it's okay. We should walk around and check out all the different spots while we're here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
Are you sure you don't mind?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. But once Tsukasa and his troupe's show and MORE MORE JUMP!'s event are over, let's come back and give it another go♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good. So, how about we go ride one of the attractions?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
The Sanrio Character Boat Ride was so fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Kitty and her friends baking sweets and partying together was adorable.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When the white and brown bunnies came out, Shiho's eyes lit right up!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're imagining things...
And they're called SUGARBUNNIES.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
You seem to know an awful lot about Sanrio characters, don't you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm so happy I got to meet Marroncream. When I was little, I had a Marroncream bag and I used to take it everywhere with me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can see that. You both have a certain warm, tender vibe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, Marroncream bakes sweets like Honami too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, you really are a fan, aren't you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, I saw you took lots of pics of Kitty and Daniel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. They looked so cute in their party outfits.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kitty and Daniel are childhood friends, but got separated for a while when his family moved for his dad's job.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So I thought it was really nice to see them together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
I hope from now on they can be together forever.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ooh ooh! Can we go to the Character Greeting Residence next?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's where you meet and take photos with Hello Kitty and friends. I gotta meet Purin!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
“Purin”...
Oh, you mean Pompompurin?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I used to have a Pompompurin scented eraser back in elementary school. Ah, it takes me back!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh yeah, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You were always sniffing it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, of course I was! It made me feel like I was having pudding.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's go meet Purin♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa...
Waaah!
Purin's so cuuute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look how his belly goes pom pom! Hehehe, lemme go pom pom too♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I think he likes her imitation.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So cute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, now he's shaking his tail feather.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! Like this? Shake-a-shake-a-shake-a♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Looks like you two are already great friends.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe♪

rows.Speaker: Puroland Staff Member
rows.Line: Okay, now smile for a picture!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehehe...
Thanks for the picture, Purin! Let's meet again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa, the time really flew by. We should head over to the stage for Tsukasa and his troupe's show soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Can't wait to see them perform♪
